**North-star / mission angle.** Watsi = direct-impact medical crowdfunding ("The Power of Human Connection"; 100% model, radical transparency). Content should connect a **specific human patient story** to the **donate-to-fund-treatment** action. Two recurring formats: (1) **patient-story "Original Series"** (established by the Alvin cut — e.g. Moo, Myo: name the patient, the condition, the surgery, who funded it, the recovery, close on a Universal Fund / `watsi.org` CTA); (2) **Roll Call** interview-clip series (partner/staff voices, 15–30s, Watsi-blue/logo style). A cut is ON-TRACK when it leads with a real patient/human, lands the transparency/impact beat, and closes on the Universal Fund + `watsi.org` CTA; OFF-TRACK if it's a generic org promo with no patient/human specificity.
**Hard brand rules (on-screen):**
- **`watsi.org` CTA is ALL LOWERCASE** (Monday brand rule; reaffirmed on the Alvin cut). Display org name is **"Watsi"** (capital W only) — never "WATSI".
- **Universal Fund** = flagship CTA program (both words capitalized) → `watsi.org/universal-fund`. **Clear the Queue** / **Giving Tuesday** = campaign tentpoles.
- **Children's Surgical Centre** — British "Centre" spelling is the official partner name (Cambodia/Phnom Penh).
- **Watsi-blue + logo style** approved for Roll Call intros; partnership context (e.g. "helped 15,000 people") lives in a **caption**, not baked into the video.
- **Privacy/sensitivity:** patients are vulnerable subjects — never sensationalize. **G (engineer)** = B-roll only, no on-camera interview. On the Myo/BCMF refugee-camp footage, **avoid showing the Malteser International van** (client steer).
**“WHO GIVES?” campaign look — Sonam’s direction, locked 2026-08-05 (SUPERSEDES the Roll Call / Original Series treatment for THIS campaign only).** Sonam is the client and her direction governs; where an older brief or a Frame.io note says otherwise, hers wins. Reference: instagram.com/p/DbMB6VTshoF — very simple, clean-cut, minimal motion.
- **Do NOT use the Roll Call / Original Series treatment on Who Gives cuts:** no house captions, no Original Series end screen, **no patient B-roll bed**. Donor clips stay untouched — no grading, no reframing, no cleaning room tone.
- **Full-frame campaign gradient**, sampled off the live `watsi.org/who-gives` (don’t guess — open the page). Lots of air.
- **The circle is the core mechanic:** ring of donor faces → push into one face → Watsi’s own play button resting on it clicks (audible) → clip plays full frame → pull back out to the ring. That push-out/push-in IS the transition — no wipes, no slides, no cuts to black.

- **CLOSE:** `Tell us your story.` / `watsi.org/who-gives` + replay button, on the gradient. **Nothing else — no logo lockup, no donate button, no stats.**
- **Credits:** first name + year only, matching the live page (e.g. `David · Supporter since 2016`) — no surname, company or job title, even when the donor names them in their own audio. **Exceptions:** Grace Garey gets `Grace Garey · Co-Founder, Watsi` **landing late, not on the open** (an unlabelled co-founder in a donor montage reads as astroturf); Dr. Tiffany Chow’s surgeon title was still pending Sonam’s call as of 2026-08-06 — default to the page convention until told otherwise.

## Organization Overview
Watsi is a tech-focused healthcare nonprofit that enables donors to directly fund life-changing medical treatments for patients worldwide. Their platform connects donors with specific patients at partner hospitals, with 100% of donations going directly to patient care. They're known for transparency — every dollar is tracked and donors can follow the impact of their contribution.
